# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

# Andrew Chen

Hello there! I’m a general partner at Andreessen Horowitz, investing in brand new startups as part
of **a16z Speedrun**.

I write a newsletter. You’d enjoy if you like long-form essays on startups, user growth, and network
effects — I’ve written over 650+ essays. If you want more, I’ve written The Cold Start Problem, a
best-selling book featuring interviews from the founders/teams behind Slack, Clubhouse, Zoom,
Twitch, Tinder, Reddit, Uber, Airbnb, PayPal, and more.

# Welcome to APDA. We’re here for you.

[Register Today!][59]

[Watch Now!][60]

[**Progress is Underway:**
**Recap of the First Advisory Council Meeting**][61]

## Find Parkinson’s Resources Near You

The American Parkinson Disease Association works tirelessly every day to support and empower anyone
who is impacted by Parkinson’s disease (PD). Our nationwide network provides connection and
community along with information and referral, education and support programs, health and wellness
activities, and other events to facilitate a better quality of life, while also funding vital
research. It is this grassroots structure that distinguishes APDA from other organizations serving
people with PD. We are here to help you and your loved ones every step of the way.

Use the State/Zip Code finder here to locate an APDA Chapter near you or [check out the full
listing][62].

## ** D&H Prioritizes Partners **

For more than a century, D&H has always put our partners first. To support their future growth, we
have recently expanded our dedicated sales & support teams, broadened our communities, grown our
solutions portfolio, and invested in our finance, supply chain, and marketing agency services.

**[Discover how D&H is Built for
Growth, Giving, and Generations >>][39]**

## **Honoring the Life and Legacy of Izzy Schwab **

D&H Distributing mourns the passing of Izzy Schwab, Chairman Emeritus and a lifelong steward of
the company.

Izzy's leadership, humility, and belief in people helped shape D&H into what it is today, serving
partners and communities across North America. His values continue to guide the teams at D&H.
Those wishing to share a memory or reflection are invited to visit our digital tribute wall.

[Visit Our Tribute Wall and Share Your Stories][40]

In lieu of flowers, the family has shared that those who wish to honor Izzy's memory may consider
a contribution to either of these two organizations, causes close to his heart.

Make-A-Wish
Philadelphia, Delaware & Susquehanna Valley

[Donate Here][41]

Humane Society of Harrisburg Area/Central PA

[Donate Here][42]

The family will be having a private funeral, however we also plan to host a Celebration of Life at a
future date at D&H Headquarters that will be open to friends, partners, and members of the D&H
community. For those unable to attend in person, additional ways to participate or share
sentiments will be made available.

## **Honoring the Life and Legacy of Izzy Schwab **

D&H Distributing mourns the passing of Izzy Schwab, Chairman Emeritus and a lifelong steward of
the company.

Izzy's leadership, humility, and belief in people helped shape D&H into what it is today, serving
partners and communities across North America. His values continue to guide the teams at D&H.
Those wishing to share a memory or reflection are invited to visit our digital tribute wall.

[Visit Our Tribute Wall and Share Your Stories][40]

In lieu of flowers, the family has shared that those who wish to honor Izzy's memory may consider
a contribution to either of these two organizations, causes close to his heart.

Make-A-Wish
Philadelphia, Delaware & Susquehanna Valley

[Donate Here][41]

Humane Society of Harrisburg Area/Central PA

[Donate Here][42]

The family will be having a private funeral, however we also plan to host a Celebration of Life at a
future date at D&H Headquarters that will be open to friends, partners, and members of the D&H
community. For those unable to attend in person, additional ways to participate or share
sentiments will be made available.

Continuous context and feedback for wearables and edge devices, with wire-like latency at ultra-low
power

The AI brain is ready. The nervous system is missing.

WHY NOW

## The hidden tax on Physical AI

Current radios force a choice between battery life and real-time intelligence. **To scale multimodal
AI, we must break the energy-latency trade-off.**
* **The Power Tax:** Always-on sensing drains batteries fast, forcing duty-cycling that loses
  context
* **The Latency Tax:** Standard wireless lag breaks real-time sensor fusion for Physical AI
  interactions
* **The Spectrum Tax:** Room-scale radiation wastes energy and creates interference. Wi‑R keeps link
  energy local

[Read the manifesto][38]See what's shipping

Wi-R links][System diagram showing distributed wearable network with hub and peripheral devices
connected via Wi-R links]

IXANA'S BREAKTHROUGH

## The fix: keep link energy local

RF radios radiate energy room-scale. Wi-R couples energy at the link using confined E-fields,
enabling continuous context without duty-cycling and with wire-like latency at ultra-low power.

### E-field coupling (Wi-R)

Energy stays local to the link

[Confined link illustration showing energy localized to the link]
* Energy stays local to the link
* High efficiency, low interference

The AI brain is ready. The nervous system is missing.

WHY NOW

## The hidden tax on Physical AI

Current radios force a choice between battery life and real-time intelligence. **To scale multimodal
AI, we must break the energy-latency trade-off.**
* **The Power Tax:** Always-on sensing drains batteries fast, forcing duty-cycling that loses
  context
* **The Latency Tax:** Standard wireless lag breaks real-time sensor fusion for Physical AI
  interactions
* **The Spectrum Tax:** Room-scale radiation wastes energy and creates interference. Wi‑R keeps link
  energy local

IXANA'S BREAKTHROUGH

## The fix: keep link energy local

RF radios radiate energy room-scale. Wi-R couples energy at the link using confined E-fields,
enabling continuous context without duty-cycling and with wire-like latency at ultra-low power.

Energy efficiency
50x
Lower energy per bit*
Response time
<1 ms
Latency
Consumption
1 mW
At 5 Mbit/s

# Effort Rewarded.
# Motivation Unlocked.

Myzone rewards effort, not just ability. We help individuals reach their peak and gym owners
maximise retention. Join the movement with our precision wearables, in club software, or Myzone Go.

[ Myzone for business ][58] [ Shop personal ][59]
HOW IT WORKS

## Effort. Engagement. Results.

Technology that rewards effort, connects communities, and keeps people moving, inside and outside
the gym.

#### Motivate Everyone

Reward real effort, not ability.
Motivate Everyone

#### Track What Matters

See heart rate zones and MEPs in real time.
Track What Matters

#### Connect Through Effort

Build community with friendly competition.
Connect Through Effort

## One ecosystem that moves with you

Whether you are a gym owner looking to boost retention or a mover looking to get fit, we have the
tools for you.

ALL NEW

## Myzone Go

Effortlessly connect with members' Apple and Android smartwatches, enabling everyone to join the
movement without additional equipment or complicated onboarding. 

[ Get started with Myzone Go ][60] [ Get a 14-day free trial of Myzone Go ][61]

## For fitness businesses

Grow your gym or studio with heart rate technology that drives engagement, loyalty, and results.
* Boost visits, referrals, and upgrades
* Increase retention and member lifetime value
* Monitor trends and identify at-risk members 
* Simple setup, seamless support

[ Learn how Myzone powers growth ][62] [ Speak to sales ][63]

## For individuals

Level the playing field. Track your effort. Make movement social, fun, and consistent.
* Earn Myzone Effort Points (MEPs) for every time you move
* Get real-time heart rate feedback to stay motivated
* Join a global community that celebrates effort
* Build positive fitness habits that last

## Digital advertising, AdTech, MarTech, and digital platforms are too complex for current market
## intelligence tools.

The ecosystems behind digital platforms change constantly: vendors reposition, categories blur, and
critical signals are scattered across news, websites, and code. Traditional search and raw AI agents
cannot navigate this complexity without structure.

### Signal vs Noise

Raw AI search returns unstructured PR statements and SEO spam. Polaris7 structures actual strategic
shifts, partnerships, and product launches to isolate what matters.

### No Flat Databases

Generic databases only list records. Polaris7 maps parent-child structures, competitors, and
programmatic integrations to reveal the system architecture.

### Real-Time Updates

Static PDF reports are obsolete before they are printed. Our knowledge graph daily detects strategic
shifts as they unfold across the web.

### Grounded Graph

Standard LLM agents guess answers by querying raw, unsorted search results, leading to
hallucinations. Polaris7 agents operate on a validated knowledge graph, delivering facts you can
trust.

## Markets are systems, not lists.

Markets are not flat directories of companies. They are systems of roles, capabilities,
relationships, competition and strategic movement.

Polaris7 maps complex digital ecosystems—including digital advertising, marketing technology, and
digital platforms. By structuring these highly fragmented markets, Polaris7 helps teams understand
not just who the players are, but how they actually connect and compete.

The value is not in seeing more companies. The value is in understanding the right companies in the
right context.

shifts as they unfold across the web.

Standard LLM agents guess answers by querying raw, unsorted search results, leading to
hallucinations. Polaris7 agents operate on a validated knowledge graph, delivering facts you can
trust.

relationships, competition and strategic movement.

not just who the players are, but how they actually connect and compete.

Turn fragmented market movements into resolved, structured deliverables in minutes. Polaris7 agents

Identify target companies based on capability gaps, category overlaps, and strategic positioning.

mechanics.

relationships.

## Trusted by Those Who Wear It

The RingConn Gen 2 represents this simplicity by blending sophisticated health monitoring with an
elegant design, focusing on the metrics that matter most.
[ [RinConn user information]][41]
When the dentist asked for the report of my husband's SpO2, which he forgot to bring, I showed him
the recorded monitoring in the RC2 app. The dentist was very impressed... and agreed that the oral
device was appropriate (to treat his sleep apnea).
[ [RinConn user information]Marni S.][42]
I had a pretty significant motorbike accident... The ring documented what was most likely a large
drop of blood pressure/shock and then the HR jump when the pain was starting to be realized by my
body... my ring is still showing my progress from that logged event. It’s really encouraging to see
my progress daily.
[ [RinConn user information]Rayn B.][43]

elegant design, focusing on the metrics that matter most.

the recorded monitoring in the RC2 app. The dentist was very impressed... and agreed that the oral
device was appropriate (to treat his sleep apnea).

drop of blood pressure/shock and then the HR jump when the pain was starting to be realized by my

my progress daily.

  ## [mimic robotics develops model for industrial robot training][33]
  
  by [Pieter Werner][34]
  by [Pieter Werner][35] 24 juli 2026
  
  Zurich-based mimic robotics has developed a video-action model designed to help industrial robots
  learn complex manipulation tasks from relatively small amounts of demonstration data. The model,
  called FLUX-mimic, was developed with Black Forest Labs and combines mimic robotics’ work in robot
  learning and dexterous manipulation with the architecture of Black Forest Labs’ FLUX 3 video
  model. The companies are testing the technology in manufacturing environments with Audi.
  
  [Facebook][36][Twitter][37][Linkedin][38][Email][39]
* [Bots & Bullets][40][International][41]
  
  ## [U.S. Air Force Adds $2.9 Million to Palladyne AI Robotics Programme][42]
  
  by [Marco van der Hoeven][43]
  by [Marco van der Hoeven][44] 24 juli 2026
  
  The U.S. Air Force is continuing its investment in autonomous military robotics by adding $2.9
  million to an existing development contract with Palladyne AI. The additional funding brings the
  total value of the programme to more than $10.6 million. The contract supports the development of
  Palladyne IQ, an embodied artificial intelligence architecture designed to allow robots to learn
  physical tasks from human demonstrations and subsequently perform them autonomously.
  
  [Facebook][45][Twitter][46][Linkedin][47][Email][48]
* [Bots in Society][49][International][50]
  
  ## [Ontario Lawyer Suspended Six Months After ChatGPT-Generated Fake Cases][51]
  
  by [Marco van der Hoeven][52]
  by [Marco van der Hoeven][53] 24 juli 2026
  
  An Ontario lawyer has been suspended from practising law for six months after she filed a court
  document containing fabricated case citations generated by ChatGPT, then compounded the error by
  repeatedly lying to a judge and to her regulator about what had happened. The July 16, 2026 ruling
  from the Law Society Tribunal, Law Society of Ontario v Lee, is one of the most detailed
  disciplinary decisions yet on lawyers’ use of generative AI, and a cautionary tale about how a
  technology mistake can spiral into a much bigger integrity problem.
  
  [Facebook][54][Twitter][55][Linkedin][56][Email][57]
* [Bots & Business][58][International][59]
  
  ## [NEURA Robotics and RWTH Aachen Plan Physical AI Training Facility][60]
  
  by [Pieter Werner][61]
  by [Pieter Werner][62] 23 juli 2026
  
  NEURA Robotics and RWTH Aachen University are developing a robotics training facility at the
  university’s Hightech Campus Melaten, with an opening planned by the end of 2026. The
  approximately 3,000-square-metre NEURA Gym RWTH Aachen will support robotics research, artificial
  intelligence training and the testing of robots for industrial applications. Around 20 university
  institutes are expected to participate in the facility.
  
  [Facebook][63][Twitter][64][Linkedin][65][Email][66]
* [Bots & Bullets][67][International][68]
  
  ## [Anduril Develops Autonomous Attack Aircraft][69]
  
  by [Marco van der Hoeven][70]
  by [Marco van der Hoeven][71] 23 juli 2026
  
  Anduril Industries is developing an autonomous attack rotorcraft designed to operate alongside
  crewed attack and assault aircraft in contested battlefield environments. The aircraft, called
  Thunder, is a Group 5 unmanned tiltrotor intended to carry weapons, launched effects, electronic
  warfare systems and cargo. Anduril is developing the platform with Archer Aviation and other
  industry partners, with a first flight planned for 2027.

# Staples drives your business with an extensive product assortment wherever you need it.

At Staples, we’ve been providing our customers with an extensive assortment of essential office
supplies for over 35 years. From writing supplies and paper to shredders and school supplies,
Staples is the [office supply][123] expert. We are a top provider of office chairs, desks, tables &
office furniture. We also offer the latest technology—from laptops, computers & accessories, to
printers, ink & toner, and more. We have all the tools you need to stay productive and connected,
plus a wide assortment of unexpected [new & trending products][124] like luggage, smart home
technology, gaming consoles & accessories, décor, and gift cards.


[Staples has everything you could ever need for school.]

### Back to School Made Easy at Staples

For students and parents, Staples is a one-stop shop for all [school supplies][125]. Parents and
students can find everything they need to succeed, from notebooks and art materials to backpacks and
lunch boxes. Teachers will appreciate our extensive selection of classroom essentials, including
educational materials, classroom decor, organizational tools, and more. [Find your school supply
list][126] & shop for everything you need, all in one place!


[Wireless headphones are essential while traveling.]

### Staples Travel Hub

Whether your next trip is for business or pleasure, [Staples Travel Hub][127] is your new
destination for all things travel. Find luggage and travel accessories, and tech gadgets to make
your trip run smoothly. Visit us in-store to take advantage of our [TSA PreCheck][128] and passport
services.


[Prioritizing wellness throughout your day.]

### Health & Wellness

Staples range of [health & wellness products][129] can enhance your workspace and overall
well-being. Shop ergonomic furniture & tech options, as well as smart watches, candles, essential
oils & more. Our curved whiteboard has an ergonomically crafted shape to prevent strain. And a new
selection of [guided journals][130] are available, with topics including anxiety & productivity.


[Take advantage of Staples EasyRewards and AutoRestock and check another thing off your list for
good.]

### Perks of Shopping Staples

We pride ourselves on making shopping a breeze. With [Staples Easy Rewards][131], you can earn
rewards on every purchase, plus extra rewards on your chosen bonus categories. Our
[AutoRestock][132] feature ensures you never run out of essential supplies, with easy-to-manage
subscriptions. Whether you prefer to shop in-store or online, we offer flexible options for
shipping, same-day delivery, or in-store pickup.



At Staples, we are here to help you navigate your business, office, and school needs with ease.
Explore our website and discover all that Staples has to offer. We're confident you will find
exactly what you're looking for and more.
